import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date and time to datetime
coffee_sales['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'] + ' ' + coffee_sales['time'])

# Create a total sales by date plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
daily_sales = coffee_sales.groupby('datetime').sum().reset_index()
sns.lineplot(data=daily_sales, x='datetime', y='total', marker='o')

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Total Daily Coffee Sales Over Time', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Date', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(True)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date and time to datetime
coffee_sales['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'] + ' ' + coffee_sales['time'])

# Create a total sales by date plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
daily_sales = coffee_sales.groupby('datetime').sum().reset_index()
sns.lineplot(data=daily_sales, x='datetime', y='total', marker='o')

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Total Daily Coffee Sales Over Time', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Date', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(True)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
